title: Make retained values inspectable in read-only task editors
description: At360 pixels and200-percent text, the frozen editor displays only part of the retained single-line title. The full draft value is preserved but is not exposed as a wrapped readable value beside the disabled field.
expected_behavior: Provide an accessible way to inspect the full retained task or draft value while editing remains unavailable. Preserve frozen authority, original command ownership and account-private draft isolation.
context: A nonblocking UX follow-up separate from the current3:1 disabled-text colour target. Research long values and keyboard/assistive inspection before choosing a wrapped read-only view or equivalent affordance.
